result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated — the full name is cut off due to insufficient card width or text overflow handling.
issues.suggestion: Either reduce font size, allow text wrapping, or use an ellipsis (...) with a tooltip/full name visible on tap to ensure the full restaurant name is readable.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (after 'Healthy') is partially visible on the right edge of the screen, indicating a horizontally scrollable row but with no visual affordance (e.g., fade or scroll indicator) to hint at more options.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient effect on the right edge of the filter row to indicate horizontal scrollability and improve discoverability of additional categories.
